dialogues.speaker: Zhuyu
dialogues.text: I'm alright. Picking herbs in the mountains can be quite exhausting. Fortunately, my wife has prepared some berries for me.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuyu
dialogues.text: This sweet taste really has the ability to relieve exhaustion.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuyu
dialogues.text: Still, I can't finish them all. Since you've still got a long road ahead of you, why don't you take some? Don't be shy now.
